implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory run using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted OpenAI API (gpt-5-mini). Use deterministic, scripted emulator scenarios (seeded) to produce one baseline and one guarded episode per task (90 tasks → 180 episodes). Baseline episodes: single initial generation call producing a candidate assertion. Guarded episodes: same shared_initial_candidate semantics; if deterministic validator fails, invoke at most one automated repair call (generate_validate_repair_v1). All parsing, assertion extraction, telemetry feature extraction, classifier (judge) training, scoring, CI bootstraps, and ablations implemented as CPU-only deterministic code (scikit-learn / numpy / scipy). Log and hash every emulator snapshot, LLM response, prompt, and index; perform 10% end-to-end audit re-executions (seeded). No human annotation or adjudication is used.
task_manifest_strategy: Use a deterministic seeded scenario list (seed=42) of scripted emulator topologies and telemetry generators. Assign one scenario per confirmatory task (90 scenarios). If an emulator or parser failure triggers exclusion after two deterministic retries, replace with next scenario from the seeded list to keep task_count=90.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (single prompt template → assertion extraction → deterministic validator). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (same initial candidate; deterministic syntactic/semantic validator + telemetry cross-check; if validator fails, one automated repair generation attempt). All transformations are deterministic, unit-tested, and run with fixed seeds where applicable.
randomisation_plan: Deterministic split and randomisation using seed=42 for train/validation/test partitions and for the 10% audit sample selection.
caching_plan: Cache emulator outputs, deterministic parser results, and all LLM responses (full-text + metadata) locally with SHA-256 hashes to avoid unnecessary reruns; retrieval-indexing not used (retrieval_augmented_generation=false).
failure_recovery_plan: Deterministic retries: up to 2 automatic re-executions for emulator failures or parser extraction failures. If unresolved after 2 retries, automatically replace the scenario with the next seeded scenario to preserve task_count=90 and flag replacement in logs. For any LLM API transient error, retry the single call once (counts toward maximum_model_calls). Record and exclude contaminated items if index-hash mismatch vs preregistered snapshot is detected.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (episode-level record containing: task_id, condition (baseline|guarded), prompt, full_model_response, extracted_assertion(s) [one primary assertion for confirmatory analysis], deterministic validator outputs, telemetry features, judge feature vector, judge decision (supported|unsupported), baseline label, execution metadata, hashes).
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call arithmetic: 90 tasks × 1 initial generation call = 90 calls. Up to 1 automated repair call per guarded episode in worst case → +90 calls = 180 maximum_model_calls. We set estimated_model_calls = 180 (conservative worst-case). Episodes = 180 (90 paired episodes). All classifier training, bootstraps (1000 resamples), and ablation computations executed CPU-only (scikit-learn) within the manifest wall-clock budget (≤7 days).
